rules.text: Every approach shows a valid signal (red, yellow or green) and a non-negative, finite queue.
The N/S and E/W directions are never both non-red (green or yellow) in the same second.
Before a direction turns green, the opposite direction has been red for at least all_red_seconds.
A green always ends in yellow, and every yellow lasts at least yellow_seconds before red.
No approach waits at red with vehicles queued for more than 200 seconds.

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=204 (events: []); with no preemption the cycle proceeds through full 5s yellow and 3s all-red, so all_red_clearance no longer violated

args.explanation: Emergency preemption at t=204 immediately forces EW green without completing the normal transition sequence. At step 203 NS is still in yellow (1s elapsed of 5s required) with no all-red. At step 204 EW is already green and NS red, meaning 0s of all-red elapsed (need 3s) and yellow was truncated to 1s. The emergency handler bypasses yellow_duration and all_red_clearance checks, causing both all_red_clearance and yellow_duration violations.
